title: Frieren Staffs for Ars Zero
description: Simple resource pack for myself and all Frieren fans! Swaps all spell staff models from Ars Zero to a custom Fern staff model.
body:
Hello Thank for your interest!! :3

Here's a simple model swap pack I created due to the current lack of Frieren: beyond journey's end inspired mods. Currently replaces all spell staff models, from the [Ars Nouveau](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-nouveau) add-on [Ars Zero](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-zero), to a custom model of Fern's spell staff.

Credits and Special Thanks to...

[Bavokor](https://bsky.app/profile/myenemy.bsky.social) for supplying Block Bench [3d models and textures](https://sketchfab.com/Bavokor88) for conversion!
